tolerance_choices.T05-H: Reasonable and conservative; not a hidden defect. AB04/i10 right CoP: frame-to-frame noise sigma 3.0 mm anterior, 1.3 mm lateral versus 0.06 to 0.11 mm on AB04/i0, AB04/d5, AB06/i10, AB07/i10 (about 30 to 50 times noisier). Phase minus time over 6,917 points: mean signed -0.10 mm anterior, -0.02 lateral, -0.20 vertical; 49 to 50 percent of differences positive; per-stride mean sd 0.4 to 1.1 mm. That is white noise with no offset (a registration error would give a nonzero mean of the same sign), so it is a noisy plate recording, not a registration problem. Phase and time pick different 1 kHz samples, so the noise does not cancel. The relaxed rule cannot hide an offset larger than about 0.1 mm here. Suggestion for docs: state the noisy plate signal for this leg in limitations (limitations.json does not currently name AB04/i10).
tolerance_choices.T05-I: Reasonable. Counting not gating finiteness differences matches the documented design (phase holds a whole stride for a gap, time holds only the gap frames); my sample found 0 finite mismatches for angles and moments.
tolerance_choices.T05-J: Reasonable. Pooled limb velocity gate 99.9 percent; pelvis velocity differences in my sample are at most 0.07 rad/s and power at most 0.32 W/kg, both derived on different clocks; reporting without gating is honest because the values are disclosed in README and limitations.
tolerance_choices.T05-K: Matches GT21 precedent: GT21 time table has task continuous_recording with task_id levelground_recording; UM21 has continuous_recording / treadmill_recording, reference_side none, task_info lists keys not constant across strides. Phase tasks stay in the phase table.
